input.text: 1. Add a distinct alternatives backlog, publish existing semantic/model roadmap. 2. Inspect official Laya runtime/model compatibility and local Python capabilities. 3. Fix a balanced bilingual task-pair corpus, labels, inference settings and pinned runtime/model revision before scoring. 4. Run a no-training local pilot, retain every prediction/error, measure cold load and CPU/resource costs. 5. Independently score and publish raw evidence/report, verify repository checks and leave training/alternatives as open tasks unless evidence supports further authorized work.
